answer: Social Matters >> Food & Drinks Question ID: 39943 Country: Pakistan Title: I have question that I have read in book Uswai Rasool-E-Akram Question: With reference to your fatwa (Fatwa: 762/623 =B/1429) I have question that I have read in book Uswai Rasool-E-Akram (pbuh) written by Sheikh Professor Dr Abdul Hai (RA) the Khalifa of Hakeem al-Ummah and Sheikh of Mufti Taqi Usmani that he writes with reference of Madrij al-Nabuwah (pbuh) that it is sunnah to avoid drinking water just after meal. Madarij al-Nabuwah is an authentic book, so can we practice this? Answer ID: 39943 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1477/1126/B=1433) Madarij al-Nabuwah is an authentic and reliable book. It was written by the grand scholar and Muhaddith Hadhrat Maulana Abdul Haque Muhaddith Dehlavi (رحمة الله عليه). It is written on page 17 of the book that the holy Prophet Muhammad (صلى الله عليه وسلم) did not drink water immediately after having food. The same is also written in Shamail Kubra, Vol 1, p 173, with the reference of this book. However our Shaikh Hadhrat Maulana Zakaria (رحمة الله عليه) says that one should drink some water in the middle of meal so that the context of the dua [الحمد لله الذي اطعمنا وسقانا وجعلنا مسلمين] which is recited after having meal could apply as the dua means: All praise is for Allah who has fed us, given us drink and made us amongst the Muslims. As per the views of physicians and doctors it makes the food part of the body and keeps the system of stomach accurate, and one remains away from cold, influenza and gastric problems etc. One should drink water after half an hour or 45 minutes of food. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
